name: Tekoah
overview: Tekoah is a city in the territory of Judah noted in Scripture as both a physical location and a spiritual setting. It is the home of the wise woman who interceded with King David on behalf of Absalom, demonstrating God-ordained wisdom and humility in difficult circumstances. The city was rebuilt by Rehoboam and its people participated in the repair of Jerusalem’s walls, though not all with wholehearted devotion. Additionally, Tekoah is associated with prophetic ministry and stands as a place where faith in the Lord was called for, especially in times of crisis in the surrounding wilderness.
